end.summary: Discussed plant-eaters, meat-eaters, and animals that eat both.
end.parentNote: Manav practised identifying foods and building food chains with arrows. They correctly explained that energy moves from a leaf to a caterpillar and built three chains, including algae → larvae → fish. They first mixed up what happens when one part of a chain is removed, then revised the answer during the lesson; the idea that only big animals are important was not yet fully corrected. At home, ask Manav to draw one food chain and circle the smallest living thing in it, then discuss why it matters.
